name: Valuation Timing 1 Code
definition: Specifies how the price valuation timing is done based on the timeline defined in the prospectus.

EXCP.name: Exceptional
EXCP.definition: Price valuation is done exceptionally, outside the timeframe specified in the prospectus.

USUA.name: Usual
USUA.definition: Price valuation is done within the timeframe specified in the prospectus.

PATC.name: Particular
PATC.definition: Price valuation that is done outside the usual timeframe, but in conformance with a case specified in the prospectus, eg, market closing day.
